title: Factors influencing haze formation and corneal flattening, and the impact of haze on visual acuity after conventional collagen cross-linking: a 12-month retrospective study

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License; CC0 waiver for data made available in the article)

groups.description: 47 eyes of 47 patients with progressive keratoconus (Kmax increase >= 1.0 D in 1 year and/or loss of >= 2 lines of BCDVA) treated 2017-2018 with conventional epithelium-off CXL by the Dresden protocol (8 mm debridement, 0.1% riboflavin, 3 mW/cm2 for 30 min, CSO Vega X Linker), one surgeon, Semmelweis University; patients under 18 years excluded, age range 18-38 years (Results).

exclusions.reason: mean keratometry is not Kmax (protocol inclusion 1)

exclusions.what: Change in Kmax (ΔKmax) and Spearman correlations in the Results text
exclusions.reason: text-only summary statistics and correlations, not tabulated Kmax values (protocol inclusion 4)

notes: Age group 'mixed' by the protocol definition: patients under 18 years were excluded and the age range is 18-38 years, so the youngest patients are 18 (not older than 18).
Other tabulated parameters (BCDVA, UCDVA, SEQ, ThCT in Table 1; corrected densitometry in Table 2) are not used.

series.notes: mean ± SD (Table 1 footnote); the dagger marks a Bonferroni-adjusted post hoc difference from baseline and is not part of the value; Pentacam HR, only scans of quality 'OK' accepted; n = 47 eyes at baseline; per-visit n not reported.
